subject: Vyber07/cyber-security
thesis: From the pages read, this is a gated cybersecurity dataset with a recent, unshown Wizz Air Sweden phone-number discussion; the claimed phone answer cannot be treated as known until Discussion #22 itself and an official Wizz Air source are read.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: The dataset describes itself as a cybersecurity knowledge base for AI training.
claims.quote: This is the most comprehensive cybersecurity knowledge base ever assembled for AI training.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: The dataset page states its size as 16 GB, files as 507, domains as 30+ and sources as 15+ platforms.
claims.quote: Size: 16 GB | Files: 507 | Domains: 30+ | Sources: 15+ platforms

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Access to the dataset requires agreeing to share Hugging Face information.
claims.quote: You need to agree to share your Hugging Face information to access this dataset

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Discussion #22 is titled wizz air telefonnummer Sweden-|-Kan man ringa Wizz Air? and was opened 2 days ago by yurtyurtyu.
claims.quote: wizz air telefonnummer Sweden-|-Kan man ringa Wizz Air? #22 opened 2 days ago by yurtyurtyu

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: The file listing shows folders including cloud-security, compliance and cybersecurity-knowledge-expansion.
claims.quote: cloud-security Upload comprehensive cybersecurity AI knowledge base - 507 files, 16GB, 28 domains, PhD-level content 6 months ago

claims.label: DERIVED
claims.text: The pages read do not show the body or answer of Discussion #22.
claims.math: The discussions page text lists only the title, number, age and author for #22; no answer text for #22 appears in any page read.

claims.label: UNKNOWN
claims.text: The phone number or answer stated in Discussion #22, and whether it is correct.
claims.missing: The full text of https://huggingface.co/datasets/Vyber07/cyber-security/discussions/22 and an official Wizz Air contact page

claims.label: UNKNOWN
claims.text: Whether an official Wizz Air Sweden phone number matches anything in Discussion #22.
claims.missing: An official Wizz Air website or help page stating the Sweden contact number

claims.label: UNKNOWN
claims.text: The dataset's licence terms beyond the presence of a LICENSE file in the listing.
claims.missing: The contents of the LICENSE file, which the file listing names but does not reproduce

risks: Dataset content is gated, so files and claims about their contents could not be fully verified from the pages read
